paite: Judah kumpipa Uzziah vaihawm lai leh Israel kumpipa Joas tapa Jeroboam vaihawm lai a zinling ma kum nih in, Tekoa mun ganhon veng mite lak a mi Amos thu Israel tungtang amuh:
Huan ama'n, "Zion tang a kipan TOUPA ahumham ding a, Jerusalem a kipan in a-aw asuah ding; belam veng mite gantatna munte alungkham ding ua, Karmel tang vum avuai ding," achi hi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Damaskas kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Gilead gam buhgawina sikte a agawi ziak un.
heading: Namte Tung A Pathian Thukhenna / Siria tung a thukhenna

paite: Himahleh Hazael inn ah mei ka sawl ding a, Ben-hadad kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding hi.

Huan Damaskas kho kongkhak sik ka hihtan ding a, Aven Phaizang a kipan luah mite leh Eden inn a kipan kumpipa chiang tawipa ka mangsak ding a; Siria gam mite Kir gam ah sal in a-om ding uh," TOUPA'N achi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Gaza kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka hihtawp kei ding; Edom kiang a piak ding in mi tengteng sal a api ziak un.
heading: Philistia tung a thukhenna

paite: Himahleh Gaza kulh tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding hi.

Huan Ashdod a kipan luahmi leh Ashkelon a kipan kumpipa chiang tawimi ka hihmang ding a; huan, Ekron kho tung ah ka khut ka lik ding a, Philistia mi khosuaksunte amang ding uh," Toupa PATHIAN in achi hi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi, "Tura kho tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; Edom kiang a mi tengteng apiak ua, unau tung a athukhun atheihgige louh ziak un.
heading: Tura tung a thukhenna

paite: Himahleh Tura khokulh tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding,” achi hi.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Edom tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, gawtna ka daisak kei ding; a-unau namsau in adelh a, ahehpihna tengteng apaimang a, ahehna in abotkek gige a, tangtawn a ahehna avom nilouh ziak in.
heading: Edom tung a thukhenna

paite: Himahleh Teman tung ah mei ka sawl ding a, Bozrah kumpipa' inn te akang khin ding,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ammon tate tatlekna thumte ziak in, ahi lite ziak in, agawtna ka daisak kei ding; agam uh azatsak theihna ding un, Gilead kho numei naupaite akuihkek ziak un.
heading: Ammon tung a thukhenna

paite: Himahleh Rabbah khokulh tung ah mei ka mutkuang ding a, huan, kidouna ni a kikou toh, pingpei ni a huihpi toh, akumpipa' inn te akang khin ding.
Akumpipa uh sal in aman ding ua, amiliante toh kiton in," TOUPA'N achi.
